scenes.summary: The trapped person happens to be Endfield site support technician Bronzer. He is initially infuriated that you repaired the robots without permission, but simmers out when he learns that you are the Endmin.

lines.text: You freed me from the place... Thank you so much.
I came here to fix robots. But a nearby Blight rupture forced me to seek shelter here. Ended up trapping myself in this place.
Our robots got really damaged. I must get them fixed ASAP.
What? YOU ... FIXED ... THEM?!
HOW...?! You are not allowed to do that! These robots are extremely hard to repair. If you break them...
Really? But its Originium circuitry is super complex! Even a professional needs proper training to...
I'm really sorry, Endmin. Name's Bronzer. Should've recognized you from the get-go and avoided that misunderstanding.
Me? Ask you for help? IMPOSSIBLE! Hold on... Maybe Copper was the one who asked.
Copper's my younger twin. Most people can't tell us apart.
He wanted to join me for this job... But I told him to wait at the Worker Dorms 'cos the place is too dangerous.
So, how's Copper doing anyway?
What? And I thought I told him to avoid solo assignments! Sheesh. He probably ignored my advice and went out on his own.
Being helpful is one thing, but if you're unskilled, you'll end up slowing down everyone else!
He probably got bored out of his mind and sneaked off. That's how he met you, most like.
Ugh... And it seems you helped him out too.
Here. A small token of my gratitude. Take it.
I gotta head back to the Worker Dorms. Can't afford to leave Copper on his own, you know.
I'll see you again at the Worker Dorms, Endmin.
Wait... I just noticed your outfit. Are you the ... that ... Endministrator?! Well ... if you're really the Endmin, I think the job is probably super easy for you...

options: Why are you here?
It's alright. It's not easy, but I've already fixed them.
Don't worry. I actually know how to fix them.
He did save many robots and should be safe at the Worker Dorms.
You actually asked me to help... Wait. You're Bronzer?
LBs almost got him.
Ran into an accident but he should be safe now.
You know your brother pretty well.
Yes, I am. Pleased to meet you.

scenes.summary: The trapped person happens to be Endfield site support technician Bronzer. He came here to fix damaged robots. You offer to help him but he refuses. He then realizes his control terminal is broken and has no choice but to ask for your help.

Sure... But be careful. Blight interference is really bad at this place.

I thought you asked me to help with the robot repairs.
Wait... Bronzer? I thought you're Copper.
Let me try. I don't need a terminal to fix things.

scenes.summary: Bronzer thanks you. When he learns that you met his younger twin Copper, he looks worried and decides to head back at once. Before he leaves, he tells you that you can find him at the Worker Dorms.
